purpose: Build-output determinism contract: the wrapper package build must emit identical dist bytes across consecutive builds from the same source tree.

excluded: generated output outside the built dist tree

requiredBehavior: Take the built workspace from scope.package and the hashed tree from scope.artifactTree, so this contract drives the checker rather than describing it.
Validate this contract's wiring against the Makefile and the verify plan before spending two builds.
Run the wrapper package build script twice from the repo root.
Hash file paths plus file bytes under scope.artifactTree after each build.
Fail if the hash or file count differs.
Blank Clockify live-test environment variables during the checker.
